newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nedcor, SMK joint winners of H1 Reuters rand poll.
newsitem.headline: Nedcor, SMK joint winners of H1 Reuters rand poll.

text.p: Nedcor group economist Dennis Dykes and Herman van Papendorp of SMK Securities are joint winners of Reuters' first-half 1997 rand poll.
Both receive a case of wine.

Economists were polled in March on the value of the rand against the dollar at the end of June. Dykes and van Papendorp both predicted 4.51 -- the closest forecast to the actual rate of 4.5280/5310 at 1400 GMT on June 30.
Forecasts for the exchange rate at the end of the first half ranged between 4.37 and 4.70 with the average 4.55.

Over the coming six months most analysts expect the rand to weaken further, with the consensus prediction for a rate of 4.68 by the year-end. The next winner (or winners) will be announcd in January 1997.
Reuters published its latest quarterly survey of 31 economists, detailing expectations for the South African economy up to 1999, last week.
